newsitem.title: USA: Quigley to split shrs, sees Q1 $0.30/shr.
newsitem.headline: Quigley to split shrs, sees Q1 $0.30/shr.

text.p: Quigley Corp said on Thursday that it will conduct a two-for-one stock split effective on January 15, 1997.
The number of shares outstanding could not immediately be determined.

Preliminary results for the company's first fiscal quarter ended December 31, 1996, indicate revenues of $3.9 million and anticipated net earnings for the first quarter of $1.8 million or $0.30 per share, the company said.

As of December 31, 1996, Quigley said it had a purchase order backlog of over $11 million for its Cold-Eeze product and was implementing its previously announced plan to increase manufacturing capacity to approximately $1.5 million per week.

For the fiscal year ended September 1996, Quigley reported revenues of $1,049,561 and a loss of $694,269 or $0.15 per share, compared with revenues of $501,903 and a loss of $152,556 for fiscal year ending 1995.
Fiscal 1996 results reflect one-time costs associated with the completion of the company's research and development and distribution of its Cold-Eeze cold relief product.
